title: Power Failure During Cycle
shortDescription: The dishwasher lost power during a wash cycle.
fullDescription:
PF indicates the dishwasher experienced a power interruption mid-cycle. Viking dishwashers preserve cycle state and resume when power returns, but display PF to alert the user.

Press START to clear the code and resume. If PF occurs repeatedly without actual outages, investigate the outlet, breaker, and door latch (loss of continuity during operation).

fixSteps.title: Clear code
fixSteps.instruction: Press START/CANCEL to clear PF and resume.

fixSteps.title: Inspect latch
fixSteps.instruction: Door must latch firmly; check latch alignment.

whenToCallPro: Only if electrical outlet needs replacement or breaker issues persist.

title: Drain Error
shortDescription: The dishwasher failed to drain within expected time.
fullDescription:
dE indicates water remains in the tub after the drain cycle. The drain pump, check valve, air gap, or disposal connection is likely obstructed. Standing water under the filter is the hallmark symptom.

Start with the easy fixes: clean the filter, check the disposal plug (if new install), and inspect the drain hose for kinks.

fixSteps.title: Clean filter
fixSteps.instruction: Remove cylindrical filter, rinse food debris, reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Inspect drain hose
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect under sink, flush with water, check for clogs.

fixSteps.title: Test drain pump
fixSteps.instruction: Remove lower panel, access pump, check for debris in impeller.

whenToCallPro: If drain pump needs replacement and you're uncomfortable with under-tub access.
videoSearchQuery: Viking dishwasher dE drain error fix

faq.a: Check that the disposal knockout plug was removed before connecting dishwasher drain.

title: Leak Detected
shortDescription: The anti-flood float has activated from water in the base.
fullDescription:
LE indicates the flood sensor/float in the drip pan has been triggered. Viking dishwashers have a pan under the tub with a float switch; any leak from the tub, hoses, or pump collects here and triggers the emergency drain.

The unit will continuously drain until dried and reset. Find the leak source before returning to service.

fixSteps.title: Stop and unplug
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off breaker; absorb any floor water.

fixSteps.title: Access base
fixSteps.instruction: Remove kickplate; look for pooled water in pan.

fixSteps.title: Dry pan and reset
fixSteps.instruction: Dry thoroughly with towels; let air-dry 24 hours; restore power.

whenToCallPro: If leak source cannot be found or water damage has occurred to cabinets.
videoSearchQuery: Viking dishwasher LE leak error fix

faq.a: Typically yes under homeowner's policy; document leak source and damage.

title: Unbalanced Wash Load
shortDescription: The dishwasher detected abnormal operation, possibly from load imbalance.
fullDescription:
UE indicates operation irregularities such as dishes blocking the spray arm, excessive sudsing, or water feedback errors. Remove the load, check spray-arm rotation, and restart.

Rarely, UE indicates a pump or motor issue. Most often it's a loading problem.

causes.cause: Tall items blocking upper spray arm

fixSteps.title: Rearrange load
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm spray arms rotate freely; avoid large overlap.

fixSteps.title: Check detergent
fixSteps.instruction: Only use dishwasher detergent — never dish soap.

fixSteps.title: Run rinse-only
fixSteps.instruction: If suds suspected, run rinse cycle to clear foam.

whenToCallPro: Only if error persists after load adjustment.

faq.a: Run a rinse cycle or add a tablespoon of vegetable oil to break surface tension.

title: Water Inlet Fault
shortDescription: The dishwasher did not fill with water within the expected time.
fullDescription:
F1 indicates the fill cycle exceeded its timer without reaching proper water level. The inlet valve, water supply, or fill sensor may be at fault.

Verify the water supply valve is open and the inlet hose/screen is clear. A failed inlet valve is the most common part replacement.

fixSteps.title: Open supply
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm shutoff under sink is fully open.

fixSteps.title: Clean screen
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect inlet hose at valve and clean mesh screen.

fixSteps.title: Replace valve
fixSteps.instruction: If valve doesn't click on, replace solenoid.

videoSearchQuery: Viking dishwasher F1 fill error fix

faq.a: Viking recommends 120F hot water for best cleaning.

title: Overfill Condition
shortDescription: Water level exceeded the upper threshold.
fullDescription:
F2 means the pressure/level sensor detected too much water. The inlet valve is commanded off, but water continues — indicates a stuck valve or faulty sensor.

Shut off the supply and diagnose. Leaving the unit powered with a stuck valve will overflow.

fixSteps.title: Replace inlet valve
fixSteps.instruction: Most common fix — valve stuck with debris.

fixSteps.title: Test level sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Blow into hose to the switch; should click.

whenToCallPro: If control relay is stuck, board replacement needed.

faq.a: Yes — shut off water supply immediately.

title: Water Heating Fault
shortDescription: Water did not reach target temperature.
fullDescription:
F3 indicates the heating element failed to raise water to the cycle temperature within allotted time. The element, high-limit thermostat, or temp sensor could be at fault.

Supplying proper 120F hot water dramatically reduces heater runtime. Cold inlet connections are common on newer installs.

fixSteps.title: Check thermostat
fixSteps.instruction: High-limit should be closed at room temp.

fixSteps.title: Replace element
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect power, drain tub, swap heating element.

whenToCallPro: If tub needs removal to access element.
videoSearchQuery: Viking dishwasher F3 heating error fix

faq.q: Can I run on cold water only?
faq.a: Yes but cycles take much longer and detergent works less effectively.

title: Wash Motor Fault
shortDescription: The circulation pump/motor is not running correctly.
fullDescription:
F4 indicates the main wash circulation pump has stalled, is drawing excess current, or has open windings. This pump drives water through the spray arms and is essential for cleaning.

Check for food debris jamming the impeller before replacing the motor.

fixSteps.title: Clear debris
fixSteps.instruction: Remove filter and access pump intake — clear glass, seeds.

fixSteps.title: Replace pump
fixSteps.instruction: If shorted/open, swap circulation pump assembly.

whenToCallPro: Pump replacement requires removing unit and tipping it.
videoSearchQuery: Viking dishwasher F4 wash motor fix

faq.a: Scrape large food off plates and clean the filter monthly.

title: Turbidity Sensor Fault
shortDescription: The soil sensor cannot read water clarity.
fullDescription:
F5 indicates the turbidity (soil) sensor is fouled or failed. This sensor determines how dirty the wash water is and adjusts cycle length. Failure causes cycles to default to maximum time.

Cleaning the sensor window with vinegar and a soft brush often restores function.

causes.cause: Sensor window coated with mineral deposits

fixSteps.title: Clean with vinegar
fixSteps.instruction: Run empty cycle with 2 cups vinegar in bottom.

fixSteps.title: Manual clean
fixSteps.instruction: Access sensor (usually near sump) and wipe lens.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: If persistent, install new turbidity sensor.

whenToCallPro: Only if sensor location requires tub removal.
videoSearchQuery: Viking dishwasher F5 turbidity sensor fix

faq.a: Unit will still wash but always on max duration — not energy efficient.

title: Control Board Communication Error
shortDescription: UI and main control cannot communicate.
fullDescription:
F6 indicates the user interface board and the main control board have lost communication over their data link. Common after power surges or if moisture enters the control housing.

Power cycle first. If persistent, inspect the harness between boards; replace the faulty board as needed.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Open door panel, reseat communication cable.

fixSteps.title: Replace board
fixSteps.instruction: Swap UI or main as diagnostic indicates.

whenToCallPro: Board swapping without correct diagnosis can waste money — pro recommended.
videoSearchQuery: Viking dishwasher F6 control error fix

faq.a: Viking dishwashers don't have user factory reset; only power cycle.
